info.title: GeoSearch API
info.description:
> **For testing and evaluation only.** This documentation and its endpoints are intended for testing and evaluation purposes only, not for production integration.

# Authentication

Every request must carry your API key in the `{{gatewayKeyHeader}}` request header. The key goes in the header only: the gateway does not accept it as a URL parameter.

```bash
curl --location '{{gatewayBase}}/api/v1/search/autocomplete?q=Riyadh&latitude=24.7136&longitude=46.6753&limit=10' \
--header '{{gatewayKeyHeader}}: YOUR_API_KEY'
```

Keep API keys out of client-side code and never commit them to source control. Details are in the [API Keys & Authentication](/docs/docs/maps/api-keys) guide.

# Available APIs

| API | Endpoint | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Autocomplete Search | `GET /api/v1/search/autocomplete` | Find places by name. |
| Get Place Types | `GET /api/v1/search/place_types` | List the place types a result can have. |
| Get Place by ID | `GET /api/v1/search/place/{place_id}` | Look up one place by its ID. |
| Reverse Geocode | `GET /api/v1/reverse/geocode` | Find the address of a location. |
| Route | `GET /api/v1/route/{profile}/{coordinates}` | Fastest route between coordinates. |
| Trip | `GET /api/v1/trip/{profile}/{coordinates}` | Fastest order for a list of stops. |

The map styles are described in the [Using SPL Maps in JavaScript](/docs/docs/maps/using-spl-maps) guide.

The `v2.0` endpoints are not available on the gateway: it answers `404 Resource not found` for them.

# Errors

The gateway always answers with a JSON body that has a `statusCode` and a `message`. Read the message: it says what is wrong.

| HTTP | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `401` | The key is missing, or it is not valid. |
| `403` | The key is valid, but its call volume quota is used up. The message says when it is replenished. |
| `404` | Nothing is served at this address. Check the base URL and the path. |
| `422` | A parameter is missing or out of range. The `detail` list says which one. |

get.description:
Returns the places whose name matches the search text.

Send a position with `latitude` and `longitude` to rank the nearest matches first. `radius_m` limits how far away a match may be.

Each result carries the name and address in English and Arabic, the place type and the location.

results.address: 12251, Al Woroud, Riyadh, Riyadh Principality, Riyadh
results.address_ar: 12251, الورود, منطقة الرياض, امارة منطقة الرياض, منطقة الرياض

get.description:
Returns the address of a location.

`latitude` and `longitude` are in decimal degrees (WGS84). `radius_m` is how far the search looks around the point. Set `na=true` to return results from the national address only.

results.name: RHWB6204
results.address: 6204, Al Olaya, Al Woroud Dist., 12215, Riyadh

get.description:
Returns the fastest route between coordinates.

- `coordinates` is a list of `lon,lat` pairs separated by `;`.
- Use `driving` for `profile`.
- Set `steps=true` for turn-by-turn instructions, and `geometries=geojson` to get the route line in GeoJSON format.

get.description:
Returns the fastest order for a list of stops, and the route through them.

- `coordinates` uses the same `lon,lat;lon,lat` form as the route API.
- `roundtrip` (default `true`) returns to the first stop.
- `source=first` fixes the first coordinate as the start, and `destination=last` fixes the last coordinate as the end.
